name: Taxually For WooCommerce
author: taxually

sections.description:
Taxually for WooCommerce seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with Taxually’s tax compliance platform. Automate tax compliance across 100+ countries — Taxually pulls your transaction data automatically, so no manual exports are required.

Key Features

  • Secure OAuth Connection – Connect your store using industry-standard OAuth 2.0 with PKCE
  • Automatic Data Sync – Transaction data is pulled automatically by Taxually
  • No Manual Exports – Set it and forget it
  • WooCommerce Integration – Settings accessible directly from WooCommerce Tax settings
  • HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually
  3. Click “Connect to Taxually” and sign in with your Taxually account
  4. Your store is now connected – Taxually will automatically pull transaction data for tax compliance

Support

Need help? Visit taxually.com/support or contact us at support@taxually.com

External services

This plugin connects to the Taxually API to enable OAuth-based authentication and to allow Taxually to pull your WooCommerce transaction data for tax compliance purposes.

Taxually API

The plugin communicates with the following Taxually API endpoints:

  • Production: https://taxually-api.azurewebsites.net
  • Test/staging: https://taxually-test-api.azurewebsites.net
  • QA: https://taxually-qa4-api.azurewebsites.net

What data is sent and when:

During the connection flow, the plugin sends the following data to the Taxually API:

  • Your store URL and store display name
  • A PKCE code challenge (a one-time cryptographic value used to secure the OAuth flow)
  • WooCommerce REST API credentials (consumer key and secret), which are transmitted once at the end of the OAuth flow so Taxually can pull order data from your store

No data is sent until you explicitly initiate the connection by clicking “Connect to Taxually” in the plugin settings. Once connected, Taxually accesses your store data (orders, products, customer addresses) directly via the WooCommerce REST API on a scheduled basis for tax compliance processing.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/taxually-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Where are the plugin settings?

Settings can be found at WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually.

Do I need a Taxally account?

Yes, you’ll need a Taxually account to connect your store. You can create one during the connection process or book a demo at https://meetings-eu1.hubspot.com/taxually/woo.

Does this plugin calculate taxes in my store?

No, this plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Taxually for tax compliance reporting. It does not modify your store’s tax calculations.

What data does this plugin share with Taxually?

The plugin creates WooCommerce REST API credentials that allow Taxually to pull your transaction data for tax compliance purposes. No data is shared automatically – Taxually only accesses data through the standard WooCommerce API when needed.

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes, you can disconnect from the plugin settings page at any time. This will revoke Taxually’s API access to your store.

Which countries does Taxually support?

Taxually supports tax compliance in 100+ countries. Visit taxually.com for the complete list.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
